book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Ruuka

content: Yeesu arabhuuribhwa iguru yo obhuturo bhwaaye

Orusiku rumwe Yeesu ahaabha mwiiseengerero rya Taatabhugya, areegya abhaatu na kubharwaazira Amangʼana Amazomu ga Taatabhugya. Niho abhakuru bha abhaseengeri, abheegya bhe emigiro na abhakaruka bha Abhayahudi bhakamuuzaku,
bhakamubhuurya, “Garya okoriri, oragakora kwo obhuturoki? Ni weewi akuheeri obhuturo bhuyo?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Na neenye ndabhabhuurya eriingʼana rimwe. Mumbuurire,
obhuturo bhwa Yohana bhwo okubatiiza abhaatu bhukarwa ku Taatabhugya wuno ari mwiisaaro kasi kubhaatu?”
Hayo, bhaari bhariibhuurya abheene bharabhuga, “Turaabhuge, bhukarwa mwiisaaro, aratubhuurya, ‘Ambe! Ndora mutaamwiikiriirye?’
Na turaamukyoore kubha obhuturo bhwaaye bhurwiiri kubhaatu, ambe abhaatu bhoosi bharatutema amagina, kwo okubha bhariikirirya kubha Yohana yaari omurooti.”
Kweego, bhakamubhuurira, “Tutamenyiri obhuturo bhwaaye bhukarweera hayi.”
Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Na neenye nitakubhabhuurira ni kwo obhuturoki ndakora gano.”
Yeesu aratuubhania abhakaangati na abharimi abhabhi

Niho, Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaatu ekireengyo kino. Akabhuga, “Yaari ariho omuutu wumwe, akeemya emizabibu mumuguundu gwaaye, akabhasagarya abharimi bhaguriibhe. Ewe, akagya orugeendo, akamara eyo eziisiku nzaru.

Eriibhaga ryo okugesa eziizabibu hano ryahikiri, akamutuma owumwe wa abhagya kubharimi bhaaye bharya, okubha bhamuhe esoondo yaaye ye eziizabibu okurwa mumuguundu gwaaye. Nawe, hano omugya yahikiri, abharimi bhayo bhakamutema, bhakamuheebha mabhoko bhusa.
“Mweene muguundu, akamutuma omugya owuundi. Nawe woosi bhakamutema no okumukorera obhubhi bhukongʼu, kyaamwe bhakamuheebha mabhoko bhusa.
Akamutuma omugya wa katatu. Wuyo woosi bhakamunyahaara, bhakamuheebha.
“Mubhuteero, mweene muguundu akabhuga, ‘Bhoono, nikorebhwi? Orugeendo runo, ndamutuma omwaana waane omuseegwa! Hamwe bharamusuuka ewe.’
“Nawe, hano abharimi bhaamuruuzi, bhakagaambana, ‘Wuno niwe omugabhi we ebhigiro bhya wiise. Tumwiite, engabho yaaye ebhe eyeetu.’
Kimwe, bhakamuruusya mumuguundu, bhakamwiita.” Niho Yeesu akabhabhuurya, “Bhoono, mweene muguundu wuyo arabhakorabhwi abharimi bhayo?
Araaze no okubhiita, no omuguundu guyo, arabhasagarya abhaandi!” Hano abhaatu bhakiigwa amangʼana gayo, bhakabhuga, “Gayo gatatuuka kweeki!”
Yeesu akabhamogorera, akabhabhuurya, “Bhoono mbe! Amakaamo gano gano obhugazuroki?

content.text: niryo ribheeri eriigina eriikuru ryo obhurusa.’

content: “Ambe, omuutu wowoosi wuno akubha agweereeri eriigina riyo, arabhunika. Kweeki, omuutu wuno eriigina riyo riraamugweere, riramubhoondora bhukongʼu.”
Abheegya bhe emigiro bhayo na abhakuru bha abhaseengeri, bhakamenya kubha ekireengyo kino ni kwiiguru waabhu. Kweego bhakeenda kumumamira hayohayo, nawe bhakoobhoha esaango ya abhaatu.
Omukoonyo iguru yo okumutiimbya Yeesu

Kweego abhakuru bha Abhayahudi, bhaari bharamwiisuunza Yeesu bhukongʼu, bhakatuma abhazuzuumi. Abhazuzuumi bhayo, bhakiikora kubha ni bhaatu bhe eheene. Nawe, bhaari ne ekeembo yo okumutega Yeesu kumangʼana gaaye, bhamugwaate no okumuhira kumwaanaangwa we Ekirooma, okubha azoongeerwe.

Kweego, abhazuzuumi bhakamubhuurya, “Ee Omweegya, tumenyiri kubha engʼana yino okugaamba no okweegya ni nzomu. Awe otakwaahura naabhe obhukuru bhwo omuutu, nawe oreegya enzira ya Taatabhugya kwo obhuheene.
Awee! Emigiro gya Musa giriikirirya, tumurihe Kaisari
eriigooti, kasi tutamuriha?”
Rugeendo rumwe Yeesu akamenya omukoonyo gwaabhu, akabhabhuurira,
“Munierekye orubhirya rwe edinaari. Epicha yino ne eriina rino, ni bhya weewi?” Bhakamubhuurira, “Ni bhya Kaisari.”
Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Ambe, bhya Kaisari, muhaane Kaisari. Na bhya Taatabhugya, muhaane Taatabhugya.”
Eriikyooro riyo rya Yeesu, rikabharuguurya bhukongʼu, bhakakira. Bhakatamwa okumutega kumangʼana gano akabhuga embere ya abhaatu.
Amakaamo Amahoreeru gareerekya bhuriho obhuryoori bhwa abhaatu
Kweego Abhasadukayo
abhaandi bhakaaza ku Yeesu. Abhasadukayo bhaheegya kubha, abhaku bhatakuryooka kweeki. Bhakamubhuurya Yeesu,
“Omweegya, Musa akatukaamira kubha, ‘Eraabhe omuutu akuuri na atigiri omukaaye akyaari kwiibhura, wamwaabhu amugabhe omutuumba wuyo, okubha amwiibhurire wamwaabhu omwaana.’
Tubhuge, bhaari bhariho abhahiiri muhuungati. Wo okutaanga akakweera omukari, akakwa akyaari kutiga omwaana.
Omusuuhu waaye wuyo wa kabhiri, [akamugabha omutuumba wuyo, woosi akakwa.]
Ekabha egoego ku wa katatu, woosi akamukweera, akakwa. Ekabha egoego kubhoosi muhuungati, bhakakweera omukari wuyowuyo, bhakakwa bhataatigiri mwaana.
Mubhuteero, omutuumba wuyo woosi akakwa.
Ambe otubhuurire, eraabhe obhuryoori bhurabhaho, omutuumba wuyo arabha omukari wawi? Bhoosi muhuungati bharya bhakamukweera no okumugabha.”
Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Abhaatu bhe eriibhaga rino bhano bhakukweera no okukweerwa.
Nawe, bhano Taatabhugya abharuuzi bhareenderwa okuryoorwa mubhaku no okwiikara kukyaaro ekihya, bhayo bhatakukweera naabhe kukweerwa kweeki.
Na bhatakukwa kweeki, kwo okubha bharabha kya bhamaraika. Bharabha abhaana bha Taatabhugya, kwo okubha bhararyoorwa mubhaku.

“Naabhe Musa akazweenia abhaatu kubha abhaku bhararyoorwa. Mumakaamo gano akakaama iguru ye ekisaka kirya kino kyaari kwaaka omuriro, akabhuga Omukuru niwe ‘Taatabhugya wa Aburahamu, Isaaka na Yaakobo.’
Kweego, yiingabha abhatatu bhayo bhaari bhakuuri eziisiku nzaru, Taatabhugya akabhuga bhayo ni bhahoru kweewe! Kweego, abhaatu abhaku na abhahoru, bhoosi ni bhahoru mumeeso gaaye.”
Niho, abheegya bhe emigiro abhaandi bhakabhuga, “Omweegya, ogaambiri bhuzomu!”
Okutaanga eriibhaga riyo, bhaari bharoobhoha kumubhuurya Yeesu amabhuuryo agaandi.
Masihi niwe we ekisyooko kya Daudi no Omukuru wa bhoosi
Nawe, Yeesu akabhabhuurya abheegya bhayo, “Kwaki abhaatu bharabhuga kubha, Masiya ni mwaana wo omutemi Daudi?
Daudi omweene, mukitabhu kya Zaburi, akabhuga,
“Eraabhe Daudi aramubhirikira Masiya, ‘Omukuru,’ bhoono erabhabhwi Masiya abhe kweeki omwaana waaye?”
Yeesu arabheegya abhaatu iguru ya abheegya bhe emigiro
Hano abhaatu bhe esaango bhaari bharamwiitegeerera, Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye,

“Mwiiriihe na abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa. Bhano bhakuseega kugeenda kunzira bhiibhohiri emyeenda gyaabhu emitaambi, no okukeeribhwa kwo obhusuuku mumiteera. Kweeki, muziinyuumba zye eziisaango, bharaseega kwiikara kubhituumbi bhye embere. Ne eraabhe bhabharaarikiri muziinyaangi, bharaseega kwiikara hano abhagini bho obhusuuku bhakwiikara.

Bharabhateesya abhatuumba eziinyuumba zyaabhu. Na bhariiyeerekya kubhaatu kwo okusabha amasabhi mataambi bhukongʼu embere wa abhaatu. Murusiku rwo okutina ekiina, abhaatu bhayo bharabhona obhutemwa bhukuru okurwa ku Taatabhugya.”

footnotes.text: Eriigina eriikuru ryo obhurusa rikeenderwa kubhwoomboki bhwa Abhayahudi. Rikasikana eziinyiki ibhiri, no okukongʼa enyuumba engima. Rora Zaburi 118:22.

Kaisari gwaari ni mweeya gwo omutemi omukuru gwa Abharooma. Yaari arakaangata ebhyaaro bhyaaru kwe enzira yo obhukorooni, naabhe ekyaaro kya Iziraeri. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Abhasadukayo. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.

Obhugazuro bhwa amangʼana ga Yeesu ni kubha, abhaatu bhayo bhatatu bhaari bhamariri kukwa, hano Taatabhugya yagaambiri, “Enye ni Taatabhugya wa Aburahamu, Isaaka na Yaakobo.” Kweego, amangʼana ga Taatabhugya gareerekya kubha bhakyaari bhahoru.
